senses.en_definition: Physical strength or energy; the capacity to exert force.
Strength or power; the degree of firmness, stability, or resolve.

messages.en: I'm worried about tomorrow's presentation. The other groups all seem really good.
Teamwork is our strength, remember? Let's practise once more tonight. I'll help you with the conclusion.
Have you joined the photography club yet?
Not yet. I'm planning to sign up this afternoon. Come along!
My internet at home keeps getting slower.
Just try turning the router off and back on again.
I was only joking earlier. Don't get upset!
I know! I was just teasing you too.
